name: claude-code-character-videos
description: Make a short vertical video with an AI character, driven by Claude Code: idea, character, song or voice, animation, word timings, a motion-graphics edit written as HTML + GSAP, and a HyperFrames render.
author: helicerat

scripts.render: npm run render:raw && npm run fix-edge
scripts.render:spin: npm run render:spin:raw && npm run fix-edge:spin
scripts.render:spin:raw: npx hyperframes@0.8.143 render examples/spin-count -q delivery -o examples/spin-count/renders/spin.raw.mp4
scripts.probe:spin: node scripts/probe.mjs examples/spin-count/assets/boy.mp4 examples/spin-count/assets/music_cut.mp3 examples/spin-count/renders/spin.raw.mp4 examples/spin-count/renders/spin.mp4
scripts.render:wing: npm run render:wing:raw && npm run fix-edge:wing
scripts.render:wing:raw: npx hyperframes@0.8.143 render examples/wing-it -q delivery -o examples/wing-it/renders/wing-it.raw.mp4
scripts.probe:wing: node scripts/probe.mjs examples/wing-it/assets/wing_v.mp4 examples/wing-it/assets/wing_a.mp3 examples/wing-it/renders/wing-it.raw.mp4 examples/wing-it/renders/wing-it.mp4
